question: When does the intellect draw forth the special parts?
premises: the measure is like a sword-edge touch at birth
it is at the same time as shining
the intellect draws forth special parts
inference: The intellect draws forth special parts at the very moment of shining.
plain_english: Thus, measured like the touch of a sword-edge at birth, at the same time as shining, the intellect draws forth the special parts.
